poster_title: Linear Graph Retrieval Augmented Generation on Large-Scale Corpora
authors: Luyao Zhuang, Shengyuan Chen, Yilin Xiao, Huachi Zhou, Yujing Zhang, Hao Chen, Qinggang Zhang, Xiao Huang
paper_info: The Department of Computing, Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Hong Kong SAR, 2025

panels.headline: Mitigating hallucinations in LLMs with external knowledge
content: RAG systems leverage external knowledge to reduce hallucinations in LLMs.
Traditional RAG systems struggle with unstructured, large-scale corpora.
Incorporating knowledge graphs captures relational structures for complex reasoning tasks.

panels.headline: Unstable and costly relation extraction in GraphRAG
content: GraphRAG methods rely on unstable relation extraction, leading to noisy graphs.
Noisy graphs degrade retrieval quality and impair generation accuracy.
GraphRAG models often underperform naive RAG approaches on real-world tasks.

panels.headline: LinearRAG constructs a Tri-Graph for efficient retrieval
content: LinearRAG uses lightweight entity extraction and semantic linking to build a Tri-Graph.
The Tri-Graph avoids the instability of traditional relation modeling and reduces indexing time by 77%.
panels.figure_caption: The overall pipeline of the proposed LinearRAG framework.

panels.headline: Evaluated on four benchmark datasets
content: Conducted extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets.
Evaluated retrieval and generation performance on the Medical dataset.
panels.figure_caption: Retrieval and Generation Performance (%) of vanilla RAG v.s. typical GraphRAG baselines.

panels.headline: LinearRAG outperforms baselines in retrieval and generation
content: LinearRAG consistently outperformed state-of-the-art baselines in retrieval quality, generation accuracy, and scalability.
Significant improvements were observed in context relevance and noise resilience.
panels.figure_caption: Result (%) of baselines and LinearRAG on four benchmark datasets.

panels.headline: LinearRAG captures implicit relationships for multi-hop reasoning
content: LinearRAG successfully captures implicit relationships without explicit relation extraction.
Enables correct multi-hop reasoning and improves retrieval and generation performance.

panels.headline: A stable and efficient framework for retrieval-augmented generation
content: LinearRAG addresses the limitations of existing GraphRAG systems.
The proposed method significantly improves retrieval and generation performance on complex, multi-hop reasoning tasks.
Further work is needed to evaluate the framework's performance on a wider range of datasets and tasks.

Fig4.caption: The overall pipeline of the proposed LinearRAG framework. I. Offline Construction.
